card.name: Boxed warning headline openings
card.fires_on: The colon or comma right after the word WARNING, and inside capitalized boxed-warning titles, just before an all-caps risk name. Also inside long capitalized words such as HEPATOTOXICITY and POLYCYSTIC.

modes.label: Colon after WARNING
modes.description: The colon or comma that introduces an all-caps boxed warning title.

modes.label: Inside all-caps medical terms
modes.description: Partway through a capitalized word in a warning title or heading.

card.writes: It seems to push toward all-caps word starts like SP, OP and AP, and away from TR.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a boxed warning title in capital letters begins or is being spelled out.
